## Problem and result

Describe the user-visible problem and the behavior after this change.

## Verification

List the targeted checks and their results. Mark heavy checks that are pending;
do not present unrun checks as passing. Include screenshots or recordings for
visual changes, with theme and desktop/mobile viewport.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Public types, manifest and working SFC example match the change.
- [ ] Applicable English and Russian documentation is updated.
- [ ] Meaningful regression / keyboard / accessibility checks cover the behavior.
- [ ] User-visible package changes have a changeset and Unreleased changelog entry.
- [ ] Breaking changes include a migration guide; public names remain compatible otherwise.
- [ ] Applicable themes, reduced motion, SSR and repeated-instance behavior were considered.

## Pending checks or acceptance

State any remaining browser, visual, package, screen-reader or owner acceptance.
For documentation-only work, identify checklist items that do not apply.
